method.wrist: narrowest 11-row median alpha width in rows 80–94% of image height; tilt is perpendicular to a 61-row centreline fit
method.upperWrist: skin edges sampled 62 SVG units above the measured bracelet wrist row, matching the standalone bow band position
method.ringFinger: alpha run nearest 72% image width, sampled over the base segment from 56% to 8% of one finger-width above the last separate row (web)
